SELECT * FROM (
WITH agg_dispenses AS (
  SELECT SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID, SUM(TRY_CAST(CAST(UNITS AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE)) AS units_dispensed FROM LOWERENVS_DB.PHARMA_RX_DEMO.dispenses GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
),
bridge_site_subjects AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SITE_ID AS SITE_ID, SUBJECT_ID AS SUBJECT_ID FROM LOWERENVS_DB.PHARMA_SITES_DEMO.site_subjects
)
SELECT
  LOWERENVS_DB.PHARMA_SITES_DEMO.sites.SITE_REGION AS site_region,
  SUM(agg_dispenses.units_dispensed) AS units_dispensed
FROM LOWERENVS_DB.PHARMA_SITES_DEMO.sites
LEFT JOIN bridge_site_subjects ON LOWERENVS_DB.PHARMA_SITES_DEMO.sites.SITE_ID = bridge_site_subjects.SITE_ID
LEFT JOIN agg_dispenses ON bridge_site_subjects.SUBJECT_ID = agg_dispenses.SUBJECT_ID
GROUP BY LOWERENVS_DB.PHARMA_SITES_DEMO.sites.SITE_REGION
) AS _capped LIMIT 201
